name: m_load_claim_feed
description: Claims staging to claim fact, with status description lookup

transformations.name: SQ_claim_feed
transformations.preSQL: DELETE FROM dw.claim_fact WHERE loss_date BETWEEN '$$WindowStart'::DATE AND '$$WindowEnd'::DATE
transformations.sqlOverride: SELECT c.claim_id, UPPER(c.policy_number) AS policy_number, c.status_code, NULLIF(c.reopen_date, '')::DATE AS reopen_date, c.claim_amount, c.loss_date FROM stg.claim_feed c WHERE c.loss_date BETWEEN '$$WindowStart'::DATE AND '$$WindowEnd'::DATE

transformations.name: LKP_claim_status
transformations.lookupSqlOverride: SELECT s.status_code AS status_code, s.status_desc AS status_desc FROM dw."ClaimStatusRef" s

transformations.name: TGT_claim_fact
transformations.postSQL: INSERT INTO dw.etl_log (proc_name, step, rows_affected) SELECT 'm_load_claim_feed', 'post', COUNT(*) FROM dw.claim_fact
